newsitem.title: FINLAND: Metra sees new engines bearing fruit 1997.
newsitem.headline: Metra sees new engines bearing fruit 1997.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Metra Oy Ab said on Wednesday its diesel unit's 1996 earnings were still burdened by an engine and production renewal programme, but the new product range will start bearing fruit in 1997.
The product range now in place would be upgraded with new vesions later but "that will be significanlty cheaper" than initial development, CEO Georg Ehrnrooth told a news conference.
"We can live fairly long with the current product range," he said, adding that a heavy diesel engine could remain in production for about 20 years. @
Metra said earlier its Wartsila Diesel unit's operating fell to 320 million markka in 1996 from 385 million in 1995.
